rounds.text: Supertex Industries Ltd is currently trading at a deep discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of just 0.20x [E2]. While the market has historically penalized the firm, the recent financial trajectory shows a dramatic turnaround with compounded profit growth of 47% over three years [E20] and a massive 300% increase over the trailing twelve months [E21]. This performance significantly outpaces the sector median profit growth of 20.0% [E77], signaling that the company is currently outperforming expectations [E56]. The market has failed to price in this fundamental shift, as the stock remains near the bottom of its 52-week range [E5]. Conceded: [E4], [E6], [E18], [E19], [E60], and [E70]. The acceleration in earnings growth [E69] suggests that the current valuation is disconnected from the company's improving operational momentum.
